Attendance Policy, JBA Policy Manual
Attendance
Each employee knows their schedule and arrives on time. Poor punctuality and absences hurt the
team and the client. An employee who cannot work a scheduled shift finds a coworker to cover it
(See Shift Replacement). A no call or no show for a scheduled shift may lead to termination.
o An employee who will be tardy or absent calls their manager on duty at least 2 hours before
the shift, unless an emergency makes that impossible. …

Standards of Conduct

Company safe.

including termination:
